bpmn2:participant.name: Example study - one actor per run (human participant or artificial agent)

bpmn2:process.studyflow:documentation: Worked example study from the manuscript: a cognitive benchmark with the structure of a randomized controlled trial that enrolls, screens, allocates, administers, excludes, analyzes, and reports a single actor (human or artificial) through one interface. The lanes are the CONSORT phases (enrolment, allocation, follow-up, analysis); the battery and the analysis pipeline are expanded subprocesses; attrition is encoded as boundary error events terminating at counted error end events; and the analysis is a set of typed data-operation nodes fixed before the first run.
bpmn2:process.name: Example study (cognitive benchmark, human and artificial cohorts)

bpmn2:task.studyflow:checklist: - [ ] Informed consent recorded - [ ] Demographic intake - [ ] Inclusion criteria checked - [ ] Exclusion criteria checked
bpmn2:task.name: Screening

cognitive:eligibilityGateway.cognitive:inclusionCriteria: Registered agent family with a pinned model version (artificial cohort)

bpmn2:exclusiveGateway.studyflow:documentation: Random allocation applies to the human cohort only; artificial agents run the full factorial, so path contrasts hold within a family.
bpmn2:exclusiveGateway.name: Randomized

bpmn2:task.studyflow:documentation: Time pressure is implemented per family: a response timeout for humans, a prompt deadline for language models.
bpmn2:task.name: Allocated to speeded path (n=...)

bpmn2:task.studyflow:documentation: Self-paced path: no response timeout for humans, no prompt deadline for language models.
bpmn2:task.name: Allocated to self-paced path (n=...)

bpmn2:subProcess.studyflow:documentation: Six Behaverse tasks plus the jsPsych Flanker, administered one trial at a time. Each trial is an explicit subprocess compressed into the task's configurations payload. A run whose failed-trial rate exceeds 20% on any task raises an error that the subprocess boundary event propagates to the counted Discontinued exit.
bpmn2:subProcess.name: Cognitive battery (one trial at a time)

bpmn2:subProcess.studyflow:documentation: The preregistered analysis pipeline: typed data-operation nodes fixed before the first run. Read, filter (the analysis exclusion the CONSORT flow reports), map to derived measures, branch on the comparison of interest, reduce in two stages, and a manual outlier review before the final write. Each step delegates through a versioned `uses` reference.
bpmn2:subProcess.name: Analysis pipeline (registered before the first run)

bpmn2:textAnnotation.bpmn2:text: Random allocation applies to the human cohort only; artificial agents run the full factorial, so path contrasts hold within a family.

One interface, any actor: the runner drives humans, language models, and bots through the same per-trial message-passing loop; every trial is logged to the BDM trials dataset under the declared schema.
Attrition is control flow, not a side note: every exit is a boundary error event, and the runner writes the participant-flow counts onto these events at run time (the CONSORT projection).

The pipeline is the preregistration: operation types, inputs, outputs, thresholds, and margins are attributes of these nodes, fixed before the first run; implementations are pinned via versioned `uses` references.
